version: v0.11.0 (release binary cass-linux-arm64.tar.gz) + all-minilm-l6-v2 via 'cass models install -y'
notes: Default search (hybrid-preferred) after 'cass models install -y' (8.1 s download, not in index_seconds) and 'cass index --full --semantic --json'; every one of the 278 queries reported search_mode=hybrid. Network was on for model download and indexing, then the container was disconnected from its network before the queries. The index covered 209 conversations and 5296 messages; the quality-tier vector index held 9723 documents. index_bytes is ~/.local/share/coding-agent-search including the 91 MB model; without the model about 109 MB. Indexing ran at the same time as the episodic-memory sync, each container limited to 4 CPUs, on a host at load average about 16 to 24. Local model inference only; no model provider called.
